rationale: Exactly two small objects do not justify a reusable cloud-storage framework or stateful infrastructure stack. A fixed command plan makes every future AWS request reviewable, keeps provider-generated values in an append-only execution report, and has no execution path in this proposal.
preconditions: a separate exact human authorization binds every unresolved AWS identity
the approved caller is an assumed least-privilege role and is not the AWS root user
the proposed bucket name is verified absent and available in the exact approved partition and region
the two exact keys have no current object, historical version, or delete marker
bucket Versioning is Enabled and Object Lock is Enabled before either evidence upload
BucketOwnerEnforced ownership, all four Block Public Access settings, explicit SSE-S3, TLS-only bucket policy, and audit data-event coverage are verified
the exact GitHub artifact is re-downloaded before expiration and all evidence identities pass
the source-contract-v2 proposal is still inactive and no confirmation response has been inspected

sequence.name: retrieve_and_validate_existing_github_evidence
requirements: download artifact ID 8826086488 from the credential-free URL identity recorded in the custody schema using authenticated GitHub transport without persisting temporary credentials
require artifact name shared-pa-statcast-attempt-03-30725195810
require 977314 bytes and ZIP SHA-256 a2fb41e783e80e067b958b0c0666d9e53cb36fffc591e33e04a0238f9c1c8fe4
verify the complete inventory bound by preservation manifest SHA-256 55e73f0f6292b3220796ee3d2524b36c29bd115d9626a6432ebc70ff7042f660
require embedded raw response SHA-256 0d4c91cb2d0eabaeaeed726fcf1d4aabd7f9d888fb4c9f90789a7ba679e0a968 and failure-package SHA-256 a166ab2c08c49238be1e45986764a6a7a960360d405b721602f28679e2bebdd0
stop before AWS on any mismatch

sequence.name: bind_and_verify_aws_identity
requirements: account, caller ARN, partition, region and applicable organization policy exactly equal the separately approved bindings

sequence.name: prove_bucket_and_keys_begin_absent
requirements: Bucket absence must be distinguished from access denial using exact account and provider response evidence
if the bucket exists unexpectedly, stop; do not enable Object Lock on it
if either exact key has any version or delete marker, stop and report; never choose another key

sequence.name: create_dedicated_bucket_only_after_separate_authorization
requirements: no bucket-wide default Object Lock retention rule is configured
wait at least 15 minutes after first enabling Versioning before object PUTs
capture every AWS request ID and response in the execution report

sequence.name: verify_bucket_controls_before_upload
requirements: every control and exact-prefix S3 object data-event audit selector must pass before upload

sequence.name: upload_artifact_exactly_once
requirements: response must include a non-null VersionId; record ETag only as metadata; retain request ID, checksum, encryption and retention response evidence

sequence.name: read_back_and_verify_exact_artifact_version
requirements: read-back is exactly 977314 bytes and SHA-256 matches
retention response is COMPLIANCE through exactly 2033-08-02T00:00:00Z
failure is incomplete retention action and blocks custody-manifest upload

sequence.name: finalize_deterministic_custody_manifest
requirements: populate only actual STS, S3 and execution fields from retained responses
never fabricate uploader, timestamp, account, partition, region, bucket, VersionId, ETag, request ID, retention or read-back result
canonicalize as UTF-8 without BOM, recursively sorted keys, compact separators and one terminal LF
validate against the exact custody schema before upload

sequence.name: upload_custody_manifest_exactly_once
requirements: response VersionId and ETag are recorded in the separate execution report, avoiding a self-referential custody-manifest hash

sequence.name: read_back_verify_manifest_and_finalize_execution_report
requirements: read the exact custody-manifest VersionId back
verify its exact byte count and SHA-256
verify COMPLIANCE retention through the exact timestamp
record both object receipts and all verification evidence in a machine-readable execution report
stop without deleting local or GitHub evidence
